title: A C struct from Python
description:
Describe a C struct with `ctypes.Structure` and pass it to C.

```
sizeof(Point) = 8
gmtime(0) -> 1970-01-01 00:00:00 (a struct tm filled in by C)
```

starter.main.py:
import ctypes
import ctypes.util


class Point(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("x", ctypes.c_int), ("y", ctypes.c_int)]


print("sizeof(Point) =", ctypes.sizeof(Point))

hints: `tm_year` counts from 1900 and `tm_mon` from 0, so add those back when printing.
requirements: Describe `struct tm` (nine `int` fields) and call `gmtime` with a `ctypes.c_long` time.
Read the fields of the returned pointer with `.contents`.
stretch: Make an array type with `Point * 3` and fill it.
